retrieved.text: For many years I have been using mascara to eliminate a few stubborn grey hairs in my eyebrows. Each day I used mascara to cover them up. However, with the Godefroy Tint Kit I no longer have to use mascara! After just my first use I am in love with the his product. From that first application the tint lasted 2 whole weeks!
retrieved.title: Best Spot Tint Ever!

retrieved.text:
I genuinely wanted to like this product, so much so that I gave it several tries. I even switched to the "light brown" option to offset how black the "dark brown" is. The issues I had with it -

- far too dark, I have medium brown hair with dark brown eyebrows. The color set as jet black, despite continually adding more developer. I feel as though they didn't even attempt to properly manipulate the shade of dark to light brown, rather it appears they just added less dye to their light brown recipe.
- requires several applications in one sitting for color to stay, dries and appears spotty
- does not last as long as expected, you must avoid water exposure to your brows for it to last more than 3-4 days

As I said, I wanted to like the brow tint because it's a great concept. I hope they can constructively use customer feedback to improve this product.
retrieved.title: I genuinely wanted to like this product

retrieved.text: I've used a lot of tint kits in the past and this one is my favorite for the price. The application is super easy and it has a list of how long you need to keep it on for whichever shade you want. I do it for a minute extra for darker brown brows. The only thing is like most brow tints it helps to put vaseline around the outside of where you want it dyed so it doesn't stain your skin(which will only last like a day anyway). Even then, this one is pretty good at only tinting the hair. Overall a great buy.

These two pictures were taken years apart but here is the point - those blonde eyebrows are virgin brows - they have never been touched. The picture to the left shows my tinted brows with a light hand at Anastasia Dip brow. Need I say more? That is a HUGE difference. I leave the dye on for 3-5 minutes. retrieved.text: This tint is really good. I have on a scale from very fair to very dark, I have dark skin so In order to get this tint as dark as I need to I need to leave it on 20 minutes believe it or not. The suggestion and directions say 5-6 minutes for darker, but most of it wipes off. If you want darker brows youre going to have to throw out the directions and wipe and reapply to your liking. I also have very sparse brows, however my sister does not and I found it required less time to get her brows darker too. like 10-14 minutes. I think it takes me longer because I shape the tint like I would "drawing on" my brows so Its dying my skin at one point. The tint begins to wear off after 3 days (this is with me avoiding washing my brows or applying moisturizers) and I would say by day 5 it's almost completely gone. So if you like the look you will have to maintain it. 4 stars because I wish it would last longer.
retrieved.title: Really Good, would be 5 stars if it lasted longer.

retrieved.text: I enjoyed this product so much I decided to buy another tube because my current one is running low. After suffering from the occasional underarm irritation from using regular deodorants and antiperspirants over the years I decided to try something new, and this product caught my eye. I did some research on it and knew about the possible skin irritation that might occur when I began using it, but luckily for me I never got any skin irritation from this product. I know people might think Primal Pit Paste is expensive for a deodorant, but I think the price is on par with traditional deodorants. At $10.95 I am still using the original tube I purchased 5 months ago and I have no doubt that it will make it to 6 months, now compare that to the price of regular deodorant/antiperspirants that cost $5 to $6 a stick and only last maybe 3 months. The scent of Royal and Rogue is great, and long lasting. That is another reason why I prefer this to regular deodorants. After a while with traditional deodorants after you sweat the mixture of the sweat and the fragrance of the deodorant becomes quite unpleasant. With Primal Pit Paste, since it neutralizes the bacteria that makes the sweat stink, you don't get that foul odor when the fragrance and sweat mix.
